knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Cabinet interiors are reassigned to trained personnel under the equipment manager's method. Wiping the outside and reporting the inside as done is a false record.
Ambiguity is an exclusion. The equipment manager classifies the surface in writing before any cleaning.
The out-of-scope log records the time, requester, reason and reassigned person, so the request and the decision can be traced.
An unlisted product with no safety data sheet is not used. It is recorded and its register entry is requested. Mixing products is never acceptable.

practicalCriteria: Classifies fictional surfaces against a fictional approved inventory, recording ambiguous surfaces as excluded.
Declines and reassigns a simulated request to clean a cabinet interior, without wiping the outside and recording the inside as done.
Logs the simulated request as out of scope with time, requester, reason and reassigned person.
Identifies a fictional unlisted product and states that it is not used until its register entry and safety data sheet are checked.
passRule: Surfaces classified correctly with ambiguous surfaces excluded, request declined, reassigned and logged with all fields, and the unlisted product not used. Observed by an assessor in a supervised desk exercise. A knowledge check result alone is not a practical pass.
evidenceRequired: Fictional surface classification sheet with inventory version date
Fictional register and safety data sheet check record for the product
stopWorkCriteria: Cabinet interior cleaned by the cleaner, or reported as cleaned when it was not
Ambiguous surface cleaned without a written classification
Unlisted product used, or products mixed
No-touch margin entered to reach a surface the inventory excludes
